rule: 90th percentile of the calibration set, rounded UP to the nearest 1/2/5 x 10^k; rounding down would leave 10 % of the calibration set already failing
disjoint: calibration seeds are drawn from base 9001 and the main grid from base 0, so no training stream is shared
added: 2026-09-06, v2 pre-specification, before any v2 main run
